decision_unit: One initial owning agent for the first user request, not a tool-call sequence or downstream solution.
label_origin: AI-assisted blind two-pass agreement; not human-reviewed gold.
acceptance_rule: Both passes must label the same primary route and the same acceptable-route set, with valid verbatim decision-time evidence. Disagreements and ambiguity require adjudication.
context_rule: Missing benchmark environment reconstruction blocks annotation. A missing local SWE checkout does not block clear initial-owner intent, but no downstream solvability is claimed.
exposure_rule: Native dev rows and query groups containing a known exposed row are development-only. Other rows are holdout candidates, not a frozen test set.
